description: Add the ability to import recipes from social media video URLs (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook) by transcribing and parsing video content into structured recipe data. This should integrate with the existing web import workflow, allowing users to paste video URLs where they would normally paste blog URLs, with the system automatically detecting and processing video content.
functional_requirements: Implement a video URL scraper that extracts metadata (title, description, thumbnail) and content from social media video URLs using local dependencies
Create a transcription pipeline that prioritizes available subtitles/captions, falling back to audio extraction and transcription when subtitles aren't available
Integrate the video import functionality into the existing web import workflow, attempting standard web scraping first and falling back to video processing when appropriate
Ensure the feature works with both single URL imports and the bulk importer interface
Process extracted video/audio content through AI to parse spoken instructions into structured recipe data (ingredients, instructions, etc.)
Maintain compatibility with existing recipe creation and editing interfaces
